messages.content: Develop a fitness app that tracks a user's location

message.content:
# Fitness App with Location Tracking: "FitTrack Pro"

I'll help you develop a comprehensive fitness app that tracks user location for outdoor workouts. Here's a complete solution:

## Project Structure

```
fittrack-pro/
├── src/
│   ├── components/
│   │   ├── MapTracker.js
│   │   ├── WorkoutStats.js
│   │   ├── RouteVisualizer.js
│   │   └── ActivityLog.js
│   ├── services/
│   │   ├── LocationService.js
│   │   ├── WorkoutService.js
│   │   └── AnalyticsService.js
│   ├── utils/
│   │   ├── distanceCalculator.js
│   │   └── timeFormatter.js
│   └── App.js
├── package.json
└── README.md
```
